lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in five to six semi-regular horizontal rows extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (dorsal edge) to shadow (ventral edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 discrete high-luminance blobs, distributed non-uniformly across the fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least four small, high-contrast teleost fish (remoras) is visible in the ventral space posterior to the pectoral fin.
